description: Encoder-level recognition of a call to a function declared in the same file. This is NOT a native opcode map: the native opcode number of these positions stays unresolved.
format_variant: SSG Team serialized research v6 / cyclic raw key (instruction index mod 8, encoded byte)

operand_contract.op1: UNUSED(symbol_index, 1) - index into the file header_symbols table

send_contract.count: exactly argument_count SEND instructions immediately before the terminator
send_contract.extended_value_meaning: native DO_FCALL, the call this SEND belongs to

callee_contract.symbol_table: header_symbols of the same encoded file
callee_contract.argument_count_must_equal: number of leading RECV of the callee

native_opcode_note: The same raw keys are mapped to native 140 in opcode_map.json. Native 140 is DECLARE_INHERITED_CLASS in PHP 5.2, which does not accept this operand shape; a compile-only capture of the pre-handler-assignment opcode field showed 200 at these positions. The native number therefore stays unresolved and is deliberately not used here.
provenance: Cross-validated on the supplied corpus: 18 call sites resolve to a function declared in the same file and the encoded argument count equals the callee RECV count in 18 of 18 cases. No PHP file was executed to obtain this.
fail_closed: Every rule is refused rather than guessed. A rejected call site keeps the whole file unsupported.
